{{Quote|I'm on approach vector four, Dak; pick 'em up in your eight.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Dak Ralter/Legends|Dak Ralter]], during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]|<ref name="The Empire Strikes Back (radio)">[[The Empire Strikes Back (radio)|''The Empire Strikes Back'' radio drama]]</ref>}}
An '''approach vector''' was a course suggested by a [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computer's]] [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]] to allow the vehicle or vessel on which it was installed to intercept or rendezvous with a designated target.
